hero.subheadline: The CRM built for aluminum, pergola and construction companies. Track every lead, automate follow-ups and hit your revenue targets — all in one place.

features.title: Everything You Need to Grow
features.subtitle: Purpose-built for aluminum, pergola and construction sales teams
features.item_1_desc: Drag-and-drop Kanban board. See every deal at a glance and never lose track of a lead.
features.item_2_desc: Smart proposal generation, text improvement and next-step recommendations powered by AI.
features.item_3_desc: Send and receive messages, share documents and automate follow-ups directly from the CRM.
features.item_4_desc: Manage your whole team in one table — roles, daily rates, active status and monthly payroll per worker.
features.item_5_desc: Real-time dashboards: revenue trends, conversion rates and team performance.
features.item_6_desc: Full support for Hebrew (RTL), Russian, English and Serbian out of the box.

showcase.label: Product Tour
showcase.title: See It in Action
showcase.showcase_1_desc: Every deal has a stage, a responsible person and a profit margin. Drag cards between columns and the system keeps track of everything — material costs, labour, payments and profit.
showcase.showcase_1_title_point_1: Kanban + Table views with real-time sync
showcase.showcase_1_title_point_3: RAL colour tracking, material orders, payment schedule
showcase.showcase_2_desc: Know exactly how your business is performing month by month. Revenue, expenses and profit broken down per deal, per team member or per product type.
showcase.showcase_2_title_point_1: Monthly revenue vs expenses vs profit table
showcase.showcase_2_title_point_2: Filter by deal type, currency and date range
showcase.showcase_3_desc: Every client conversation is logged and analysed by AI. The assistant suggests next steps, improves proposals and keeps your team on the same page — in Hebrew, Russian, English or Serbian.
showcase.showcase_3_title_point_1: Threaded client conversations with full history
showcase.showcase_3_title_point_2: AI response suggestions and proposal improvement
showcase.showcase_3_title_point_3: Supports all 4 languages with RTL for Hebrew
